investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Granitevid Labs (collaboration SaaS); Platform: AWS sa-east-1 (zones sa-east-1a/sa-east-1b/sa-east-1c); network range 10.216.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster granit-prod-saeast (EKS); Billing: a daily charge job 'premium-collection' is triggered by the in-house scheduler 'chronos-lite', which computes run times from local wall-clock time (Europe/Madrid); charges go through payment-gw to an external card processor; job executions are recorded by job name; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
